Author: @ddrsoul

Tested on Anbernic RG DS (RK3566).

### New
- **mGBA QoL**: a second mGBA core for Game Boy Advance, `mgbaqol`, picked per game in EmulationStation. It runs the game as usual on the top screen and a live companion on the bottom screen, read from the running game ([ddrsoul/mgbaqol](https://github.com/ddrsoul/mgbaqol) 0.3.0):
  - **Gen 3 Pokémon** and ROM hacks (Emerald Enhanced, Odyssey, Unbound…): party, battle with type matchups, bag, region map and wild Pokémon;
  - **Fire Emblem 7** (USA): units with hidden growths, battle odds with real hit rates, dangerous enemies, enemy ranges on the map;
  - **Advance Wars 2** (USA): armies and CO powers, a damage calculator that follows the cursor, fuel and ammo warnings, enemy reach on the map.
  
  Touch or the right stick drive it; other games and cores are unaffected, and saves are shared with the regular mGBA core.

### Updated
- **DSperate 3.0.3** (from 3.0.0): fixes Picross DS hanging after the logos, misplaced 3D geometry, fast forward with frameskip, a crash after toggling anti-aliasing and text drawn one column too wide on the GPU raster.

### Build
- The source mirror keeps working when a release asset is too big for GitHub.
- No more scheduled nightly build / mirror update runs in this fork: they were always skipped here.
